title: "Too Much Alignment; Not Enough Culture": Re-balancing cultural alignment practices in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a perspective piece and does not conduct its own empirical measurement. Instead, it critiques current quantitative benchmarks and proposes evaluating cultural alignment (and by extension, cultural bias) using qualitative and ethnographic research methods. The proposed methodology includes gathering user feedback from culturally diverse groups, conducting ethnographic analysis of AI interactions in real-world scenarios, and evaluating models on their ability to generate context-anchored, nuanced 'thick outputs'.
